body: MAINLINE056 complete; QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Corrected provenance: 6.03 MPa is the paper's pressure simulation, not a measured pressure test. Owned DF/J2 extension reuses pinned CHECK029 Q8 code. Refined indentation with the midsurface-radius reading gives 6.159021 MPa (+2.140%); four refined-contact indentation/radius scenarios span 6.1590–6.5023 MPa. Contact mesh refinement changes the peak -0.1156%; doubling contact penalty changes it −0.0105%. Linear gaps are +1.977% midsurface and +9.764% outer-radius. Guarded reference paths yield in the foam, then faces, before the implied virgin shear screen and turning point; no sourced PVC80 shear-rupture criterion was recovered. Gaussian early turns are distinguished from larger later peaks. Steel-axis, foam-flow, densification and imported-history uncertainties prevent unique calibration. Directional CR III crush/shear law requirements are sourced. No P2 gamma released. Raw paths, saved states, mesh/step/material checks, source snapshots, receipts and NFIs are pinned. All scopes released; no successor named.
